import re
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

LINE = re.compile(
    r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+(\d{2}):\d{2}:\d{2}\s+\[([A-Za-z]+)\]\s+([^:\s]+)\s*:'
)


def main():
    hours = Counter()
    modules_by_hour = defaultdict(set)
    modules = Counter()

    with open("дані/app.log", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        for raw in f:
            m = LINE.match(raw.strip())
            if not m:
                continue
            hour, level, module = m.groups()
            if level != "ERROR":
                continue
            hours[hour] += 1
            modules_by_hour[hour].add(module)
            modules[module] += 1

    out = []
    for hour in sorted(hours):
        mods = ", ".join(sorted(modules_by_hour[hour]))
        out.append(f"{hour}:00 — {hours[hour]} ({mods})")

    if modules:
        best = min(modules, key=lambda k: (-modules[k], k))
        out.append(f"Найгірший модуль: {best} ({modules[best]})")

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
